subject: Re-align demo timing with FY spend gate and CFO travel
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jones <clara.jones@evergreeninc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 10 (FY timing note)

Hi Clara,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation I put together a short demo to cover: integration options (hosted, dedicated, private), cost/latency tradeoffs, and a pilot checklist. Can we lock 30–45 minutes on Nov 10 at 10:00 AM PT?

Quick context: I know Evergreen is entering a spend gate next week for Q4 planning — if that affects timing, we can move the demo past your budget decision window. Just let me know what works.

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf (one-pager + agenda)

Proposed agenda
- 10m: objectives & success criteria
- 20m: product walkthrough (hosting modes, SLAs)
- 10m: pilot next steps / procurement checklist

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf
From: Clara Jones <clara.jones@evergreeninc.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 10 (FY timing note)

Mina —

Thanks — Nov 10 is tight for our execs. CFO will be traveling the week of the 8th for investor meetings and the finance team mentioned a short internal spending freeze until the FY replan clears (likely by mid-November). Could we push to the week of Nov 16?

Two quick asks so we can triage:
1) Can you send a high-level pricing ballpark for a 6–12 month pilot (reserved capacity vs hosted)? Procurement will want numbers.
2) Is a VPC/private deployment supported for pilot workloads? Security wants to know if we can avoid public endpoints during the trial.

If Nov 17 or 18 (afternoon ET) works for you, propose time and I’ll try to secure a short slot.

Clara Jones
Director, Platform Engineering | Evergreen Inc.
clara.jones@evergreeninc.com | 617-555-0123
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Evergreen — CFO travel / spend gate (pricing + VPC notes)

Mina / Neha — forwarding Clara’s note. Two operational points from my side before we reply:

- Pricing snapshot: I attached pricing_snapshot_v2.xlsx with two pilot bands (reserved pool vs hosted consumption) and an expected token/time SLO profile for Evergreen’s use case. Use the "pilot - conservative" column for procurement.
- VPC: we do support Private (VPC) pilots; vpc-deployment-notes.docx outlines minimal networking requirements (peering/egress rules + KMS options). Security usually asks for an IP allowlist + short-lived certs for the control plane — we can offer a scoped exception for the pilot.

Given their spend gate next week, recommend offering two demo windows (Nov 17 afternoon ET & Nov 24 morning ET) and be explicit that the pilot start can be deferred until PO/commit clears after the FY replan. Also suggest including the procurement contact on the invite once they confirm availability.

Karthik
Director, Sales Engineering
Attachment: pricing_snapshot_v2.xlsx; vpc-deployment-notes.docx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jones <clara.jones@evergreeninc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 10 (FY timing note)

Hi Clara —

Totally understand the timing. Thanks for the heads-up on the CFO travel and the spending freeze. We can absolutely move the walkthrough — would Nov 17 at 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET work for your team? That slot would let us have Karthik on the call to run pricing and deployment questions.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Pricing: I attached the snapshot Karthik referenced. The pilot band assumes 50–100k tokens/day with a short reserved buffer; we included an example monthly cost range and optional quantization/packing levers to bring down CPU/GPU expense.
- VPC: yes, we can run a scoped VPC pilot. See the vpc-deployment-notes.docx for minimum network/role mappings.

I also attached an evaluation-checklist.pdf that outlines the procurement items we typically hand to finance (PO template, SOC2 evidence, SSO/KMS checklist). If you prefer, I can share a tailored one-pager for Evergreen’s procurement team.

If Nov 17 is not possible, we can tentatively hold Nov 24 (10:00 AM PT) as a backup. I’ve added a DocuSign link for a short mutual NDA in case your legal team needs it before we demo: https://docusign.com/link/ABC123-eval-nda

Best,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: evaluation-checklist.pdf; pricing_snapshot_v2.xlsx; vpc-deployment-notes.docx
From: Clara Jones <clara.jones@evergreeninc.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Evergreen Inc. Procurement <procurement@evergreeninc.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed Nov 10 (FY timing note)

Mina, Karthik —

Appreciate the flexibility and the materials — very helpful. CFO just had the travel extended, so Nov 17 is now a stretch for his schedule. Procurement looped me in and indicated they’ll need internal approval before scheduling a live walkthrough (expected mid-week after the FY replan completes).

Can we shift the demo one more week and target Nov 24 or Dec 1 (either afternoon ET)? We’d like the CFO to be able to join for the pricing discussion if possible. If you can tentatively hold Nov 24 at 2:00 PM ET for us, procurement will follow up with a PO timeline.

Also: a quick ask from procurement — can you confirm whether invoices can be sent net-45 and if we can include Evergreen’s billing address on the pilot PO? I’ll introduce procurement on the thread once we have a tentative date.

Thanks,
Clara
